name: 993 Turbo intake distributor and branches, group 107-20 (PicoGK concept)
material_candidate: AlSi10Mg LPBF (concept assumption; the record leaves the material unknown)
picogk_enhancement: Concept base model of the intake distributor (pos 1) with its two three-runner branches (pos 18/21 context): a pill-shaped plenum fed by a throttle-side neck, three runners per bank arcing outboard and dropping onto lobed port flanges. The flow volume is modelled first and its junctions filleted into bellmouth-like entries; the wall is a uniform offset of it, so every passage is smooth and open at the six ports, the inlet and the sensor tapping. The PET record is identity only: every dimension, the layout, the runner count per branch and all interfaces are assumptions. The shut-off valve, sensors, MAF, hoses and sleeves of the record are not modelled.

cylinder_pitch_mm.note: runner spacing along the crankshaft; the M64 cylinder pitch is unpublished (M64-ACQ-0004). 118 mm is the Type 912 flat-twelve spacing reported in docs/research/917-german-engineering-sources.md, used only as an order of magnitude; the boxer bank stagger is ignored

bank_port_y_mm.note: lateral half-distance of the two head port rows from the engine centre plane; no OEM coordinate

plenum_length_mm.note: distributor (pos 1) length along X; keeps the outer runners inside the plenum

plenum_width_mm.note: distributor width; order of magnitude of fPlenumWidthMm = 90 in parts/m64-charge-air-0001/source/ChargeAirParameters.cs

plenum_centre_z_mm.note: plenum axis height above the port faces

plenum_shape_exponent.note: superellipsoid exponent of the plenum (2 = ellipsoid; higher = fuller pill shape)

runner_bore_mm.note: runner bore; no 993 Turbo port or runner diameter is published in the repository

wall_mm.note: uniform wall of the cast-style concept

port_flange_rim_mm.note: flange rim around each runner outer diameter

stud_hole_mm.note: M8 clearance assumed; no stud pattern published

stud_boss_radius_mm.note: stud lobe and nut seat radius

inlet_bore_mm.note: throttle-side inlet bore; order of magnitude of the 66 mm aftermarket intercooler connector (catalog/sources/src-ta-technix-993-intercooler-dimensions.json), not an OEM throttle interface

inlet_neck_length_mm.note: inlet neck length ahead of the plenum

sensor_boss_radius_mm.note: boss on the plenum top in the place of a pressure-transmitter tapping (pos 14 context); position and thread unknown

inner_fillet_mm.note: fillet of the flow volume: bellmouth-like runner entries and inlet blend

fillet_mm.note: outer blend of runners, flanges and bosses

open_interfaces: cylinder-head intake port positions, bores, flange faces and stud pattern
shut-off valve (pos 10) and pressure transmitter (pos 14) mountings
split between pos 1 and the pos 18/21 manifolds
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
